title: Taskmaster
summary: Clear the reapers, then stop their repair support when Taskmaster XVII activates.
overview: Clear the reapers, then stop their repair support when Taskmaster XVII activates.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Defeat all four active creep reapers to summon the Taskmaster.
At 75%, the Taskmaster begins its repair sequence and activates further reapers.
Destroy active repair adds promptly to reduce the boss's regeneration.
